entries.en: I have tests tomorrow.[n]I should study today...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, I'm comin' in.
What's up?
We're closed.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What? I thought you'd be[n]more surprised to see me.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh, come on. I'm a[n]special customer.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I told you before, your room's too[n]borin'. So, bein' the awesome guy[n]I am, I brought you somethin'!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I found this layin' around at[n]home. Do you know what a "Wing[n]Chun dummy" is?
Ryuji took out a large bag...
...This looks like that training[n]dummy that shows up in a lot[n]of kung fu movies.
I obtained [clr 2]Wing Chun[n]dummy[clr 27] from Ryuji.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So, you free after this?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I totally bombed today's practice[n]test. I'm gonna have to actually[n]study for the real one tomorrow.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Do you wanna study together?[n]I'll be able to study better[n]here than at home.
Even though nothing goes[n]smoothly with Ryuji around,[n]I decided to study with him.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ugh, this is such a drag.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Why do we have to study[n]history, anyway? It's[n]all in the past.
I agree.
To avoid making past mistakes.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah! Who cares[n]about the past?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What's with that cliché[n]line? Can't I just complain[n]a little bit?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: "All the world under one roof,"[n]is fine and all, but what about[n]the current state of this country?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wish I could finish these tests [n]so I can concentrate on making a good country...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Next is... the Meiji Restoration.[n]I'm actually pretty good with[n]this part.
I feel I gained [clr 1]Knowledge[clr 27][n]from studying with Ryuji...
I'll work hard on the tests[n]tomorrow, too...
